args.title: Fix hourly purge of failed uploads to delete expired entries
args.body:
File: src/ingest/worker.ts

The current hourly purge process fails due to `AccessDenied` for specific upload keys. This change will ensure that the expired uploads older than the retention period are removed correctly.

args.title: Fix decimal comma import issue for Belgian and French bank statements
args.body:
File: src/importers/bank_statement_importer.ts

Currently, amounts with a decimal comma (e.g., -12,50 and 1.234,56) are misinterpreted when imported, resulting in values being a hundred times too large. This change will ensure that these amounts are correctly parsed according to the Belgian and French formatting where commas are used as decimal separators.

args.title: Fix upload failure after CSV row correction
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The upload process currently fails to notify the user of the specific row causing an error, leading to confusion. We should modify the upload form to ensure it properly handles and communicates upload failures to prevent user frustration.
